_comment: docs/wording.md governs this file the same as it governs the message
catalogues: state facts plainly, sentence case, fixed terminology, no
rhetorical questions, no exclamation marks, and third-person objective
Chinese without 你. A listing image is a user-visible string that happens
to be rendered as a picture.
The captures inside the frames are in the listing's own language too. The
extension ships its whole interface in both, so an English screenshot on a
Chinese listing would be a choice rather than a saving.
One idea per slide, and the five read in order: what the readout says while
a stroke is drawn, what the trigger opens, what stays on screen while
drawing, what can be reassigned, and what a first install states.
*asterisks* mark the phrase that takes the accent gradient. One per
heading at most: two accents is no accent.

en.h1: The count is on screen *before the release*
en.p: Hold the trigger and draw. The readout names the command the stroke currently matches, and counts what it will affect: four tabs, to the right of this one.

zh_TW.h1: 還沒放開，*就知道會關掉幾個*
zh_TW.p: 按住觸發鍵畫一筆，指令提示會即時說出對應的指令，連影響範圍都先算好：右側四個分頁。

en.h1: Hold the trigger and *every tab becomes a tile*
en.p: Each tile carries the title, the site and the icon. Release over one to switch to that tab, with no click and no context menu after it.

zh_TW.h1: 按住觸發鍵，*分頁一次全攤開*
zh_TW.p: 每一格都有標題、網站和圖示。在想去的那一格上放開就切過去，過程中不產生點擊，也不會開啟右鍵選單。

en.h1: The gesture list stays *on screen while drawing*
en.p: The cheatsheet is docked to the bottom edge for as long as the trigger is held, and lists the strokes currently assigned rather than the ones that shipped.

zh_TW.h1: 畫的時候，*手勢清單就在畫面上*
zh_TW.p: 觸發鍵按著不放，手勢清單就固定在畫面下緣，列的是目前指派的手勢，不是出廠設定。

en.p: One stroke per command, drawn in the settings page with the code the page itself uses. Trail colour, overlay size and the sites left out are on the same page.

zh_TW.p: 一個指令配一組筆畫，在設定頁直接用滑鼠畫，辨識方式和網頁上完全相同。軌跡顏色、畫面大小、停用的網站也都在同一頁。

en.h1: It names the trigger for *this device*, on install
en.p: The context menu behaves differently on each platform, so the trigger is chosen per device. The page that opens on install states which one applies here.

zh_TW.h1: 裝好就先說明，*這台該按哪一顆*
zh_TW.p: 右鍵選單的行為每個平台都不一樣，所以觸發鍵依裝置各自設定。安裝時開啟的頁面會直接寫出這台適用的按鍵。
